# Support

- Bugs, feature requests and questions about this provider: open an
  [issue](https://github.com/FHL-Services-Inc/terraform-provider-postgresql/issues)
  in this repository.
- Documentation: the provider's page in the
  [Terraform Registry](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/FHL-Services-Inc/postgresql/latest/docs).
- General Terraform questions: the [HashiCorp Discuss forum](https://discuss.hashicorp.com/c/terraform-core/27).
- Security issues: see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md); please don't report them in public issues.
